text:
isabel: hey everyone — i'm Isabel, starting on eng today. quick q: where should I post laptop/setup (wifi/VPN) problems vs general who-to-ask/process questions? also, how do I quiet the onboarding-bot pings if they're too chatty? :wave:

matt: welcome Isabel :tada: For device/login stuff ping @it-support (DM works or drop a message in #help). For "who owns X" or process questions, ask in #new-hires for cross-org answers or #eng for eng-specific stuff. If it's a one-off urgent issue DM the oncall.

it-support-bot: To open a support ticket run the slash command or DM me. Example:
```
/ticket create "VPN can't connect" --attach logs
```
Estimated response: 2-4 hours (longer during global deploys).

maya: +1 to the above. For onboarding-bot pings you can opt out by DMing @onboarding-bot and sending: 
```
unsubscribe
```
or change notifications: Slack > You > Preferences > Notifications and mute the bot's channel. Also please don't post creds or screenshots with secrets in public channels — use a ticket or a secure doc.

lina: hi Isabel — also add a short intro to #introductions (timezone, role, repos you need access to). Folks will proactively add you to common repos. If you need access escalations, mention @lina or file an IT ticket with the repo list.

isabel: thanks y'all! DMing @it-support now and will post intro to #introductions. appreciate the tips :smile:
